subject.why: The feast table includes the requested roast, fruit bowl, cake, mast, and pirate flag.

category.why: The table stands firmly on wide deck planks with a low angle and simple backdrop.

clean.why: No UI, text, watermarks, or characters are present.

framing.why: The table is centrally placed with clear silhouettes and good border margins.

colour.why: Warm, juicy sunset palette with strong separation between foreground and background.

detail.why: Forms are chunky and stylized with no noisy textures or clutter.

style.why: Matches the reference style with soft 3D volumes, smooth sheen, and clean edges.
